summary: Frontend-only verification of two changes: (1) Kasir sidebar no longer shows Dashboard and Kasir login redirects to /pos; (2) new ShareNotaImageButton ('Bagikan Nota sebagai Gambar') is present and functional inside the POS receipt-dialog for both Kasir and Owner. All four requested scenarios PASSED with no JS console errors.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 POS transactions (one as Kasir, one as Owner) via full checkout flow (BANNER - 380GSM 1x @ Rp40.000, cash Rp1.000.000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kasir POS checkout confirmed works end-to-end. Payment dialog requires filling the visible Nominal Diterima input (last input in dialog[role='dialog']) with an amount >= total before clicking 'Konfirmasi & Cetak Struk', otherwise a 'Nominal bayar kurang' toast blocks. Variant dialog uses [data-testid='variant-quickadd-<id>'] / variant-plus / variant-add to add qty and [data-testid='variant-done-button'] to confirm. Receipt dialog exposes [data-testid='receipt-dialog'] with new [data-testid='nota-share-image-button'] label 'Bagikan Nota sebagai Gambar'. Kasir sidebar Dashboard link count = 0, Owner = 1 (verified on /riwayat layout page).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - all requested behaviors verified. Kasir land-on-POS is enforced in /app/frontend/src/App.js HomeIndex + /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx and NAV in Layout.jsx correctly omits 'Kasir' from Dashboard item roles. ShareNotaImageButton reused from NotaDialog.jsx renders html2canvas PNG; on desktop fallback path triggered download and toast 'Gambar nota diunduh — tinggal lampirkan di WhatsApp' (Kasir). Owner path produced no toast but also no JS error, consistent with navigator.share/download branching depending on capability.
